name: rami_payment_webhook_failures
description: Count of payment- or webhook-processing failures logged by rami-api. Tune the filter to the backend's actual log fields before relying on it (pino structured logs; the redaction list in backend/src/logger keeps secrets out).
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="rami-api" AND severity>=ERROR AND (textPayload:("payment" OR "webhook" OR "refund") OR jsonPayload.context=~"Payment|Webhook|Refund")
